streetcomplete.description:
StreetComplete is a free, open-source OpenStreetMap editor that makes contributing to better maps easy, even without prior mapping experience.

Explore your surroundings and discover simple map quests highlighting missing or incomplete information. Answer questions about roads, sidewalks, cycling infrastructure, building details, shop opening hours, accessibility, parking, and other real-world features. Your answers help improve OpenStreetMap for everyone.

The app automatically finds nearby mapping tasks and displays them as markers on an interactive map. Tap a quest, check the location in person, and provide the requested information. StreetComplete translates your answers into structured OpenStreetMap edits without requiring knowledge of complex tagging rules.

Work offline while surveying, with changes uploaded when connectivity is available. Additional map overlays, notes, and contribution statistics make it easier to explore and improve local map data.

StreetComplete is maintained by Tobias Zwick and contributors under the GPL-3.0 license. An OpenStreetMap account is required to upload contributions, and an internet connection is needed to download new mapping tasks and synchronize edits.
